title: Feature Settings
description: Enable or disable various features of the extension. These settings correspond to the configurations in your `settings.json`.

saveStatus.savedWithSync: Saved to extension storage, and synced {{count}} change(s) to settings.json.

externalChanges.banner: Configuration was updated externally. Click to refresh.

enableEmoji.label: Enable Emoji
enableEmoji.description: Include an emoji in the commit message subject.

enableBody.label: Enable Commit Body
enableBody.description: Generate a detailed commit message body.

enableLayeredCommit.label: Enable Layered Commit
enableLayeredCommit.description: Generate commit messages in layers for complex changes.

enableGlobalContext.label: Enable Global Context
enableGlobalContext.description: Use global context from the codebase for better messages.

enableSemanticGrouping.label: Enable Semantic Grouping
enableSemanticGrouping.description: When multiple files are selected, group them semantically and allow one-click staged group application.

useRecentCommitsAsReference.label: Use Recent Commits as Reference
useRecentCommitsAsReference.description: Learn from recent commits to match the project's style.

largePromptAction.label: When Prompt Is Too Large
largePromptAction.description: Choose a default action when the prompt is near the model limit to avoid repeated popups.

branchNamePostAction.label: Default Action After Branch Name Generation
branchNamePostAction.description: Choose the default operation after branch name is generated to reduce extra prompts.

branchNameSelectionMode.label: Branch Suggestion Selection Mode
branchNameSelectionMode.description: Choose whether to use the top suggestion directly or open an editable suggestion list.

branchCreationFailureAction.label: Action on Branch Creation Failure
branchCreationFailureAction.description: Choose the default action when auto branch creation fails.

enableThirdPartyModelCatalog.label: Use Third-Party Model Catalog
enableThirdPartyModelCatalog.description: Use OpenRouter/LiteLLM synced metadata when provider APIs do not return max input tokens.

enableAdaptiveInputLimitLearning.label: Learn Limit from 429 Errors
enableAdaptiveInputLimitLearning.description: If a provider returns token-limit errors, record the discovered limit and apply it next time.

diffTruncationStrategy.label: Diff Truncation Strategy
diffTruncationStrategy.description: Semantic keeps high-signal files first. Direct keeps the earliest raw content.

maxInputTokensPerRequest.label: Request Input Token Cap
maxInputTokensPerRequest.description: 0 means auto. Set a positive value to force a strict input token cap before sending requests.

modelRegistry.label: Model Registry
modelRegistry.description: Manage custom model limits and view synced third-party model catalog in one place.

sync.label: Sync Model Catalog
sync.description: Manually refresh model context limits from third-party sources (OpenRouter/LiteLLM).

catalog.note: This is a synced snapshot for readability and pre-checks, not a provider live API response.

quickActions.title: Quick Actions
quickActions.description: Run common commands directly from WebView while keeping command palette workflows available.

modelCatalogViewer.title: Synced Model Catalog
modelCatalogViewer.description: Unified view of synced third-party model metadata and custom model overrides.

simplifyDiff.label: Simplify Diff
simplifyDiff.description: Use a simplified diff for analysis.

autoDetectStaged.label: Auto Detect Staged Changes
autoDetectStaged.description: Automatically use staged changes if available.

fallbackToAll.label: Fallback to All Changes
fallbackToAll.description: If no staged changes, fallback to all changes in the repository.
